title: File control: WRITE, REWRITE and DELETE that name the file with DATASET, the older spelling of FILE; DUPREC, INVREQ RESP2 30 and NOTFND RESP2 80

scenarios.summary: WRITE DATASET of a new key is NORMAL and a READ DATASET of it returns the record; WRITE of a key already there is DUPREC and leaves the stored record unchanged
REWRITE DATASET with no READ UPDATE is INVREQ RESP2 30; READ UPDATE DATASET then REWRITE DATASET replaces the record
DELETE DATASET RIDFLD removes a record (a READ of it, and a second DELETE, are NOTFND RESP2 80); a neighbour is untouched
